final_target: ICStudio 1.0 as defined by AGENTS.md M8
assessment: M0 and M1 are accepted. M1 completed the design-kernel and headless-skeleton contract with an Electron and React desktop shell, a WebGPU scene prototype, a least-privilege Rust UI bridge, and automated proof that CLI, UI, and MCP expose the same authoritative project state and revision. GitHub Actions run 30795833188 validated the locked npm graph, strict Rust and TypeScript builds, UI security tests, parser and recovery tests, the one-million-shape baseline, licence policy, dual SPDX evidence, and the pinned non-root Linux container on Ubuntu, macOS, and Windows. M2 and all design-editor and solver capabilities remain unstarted.

known_risks: The MCP gateway uses a bounded bootstrap JSON parser rather than a complete schema-generated implementation
The release-build workflow defines native targets but has not yet been exercised by a version tag
The reference spatial index is not a production R-tree or hierarchical layout index
Transactions remain add-only and do not provide undo redo or concurrent writer coordination
The M1 desktop shell is a read-only project snapshot and WebGPU scene prototype; packaging and design editors are not implemented
The PDK implementation stores metadata only and does not execute PCells rule decks or compact models
SPICE and GDSII support is structural parser scaffolding rather than full interoperability
The result database stores bounded scalar vectors without streaming compression plotting or solver integration
No schematic editor layout editor simulator verification extraction EM thermal photonic optimization or tapeout capability exists
